project.name: Talky
project.purpose: Talky là ứng dụng chat messenger iOS cho phép người dùng đăng ký/đăng nhập, trò chuyện 1-1 theo thời gian thực và nhận thông báo đẩy khi có tin nhắn mới.

concept_prerequisites.judge_rationale: API calls are asynchronous; understanding async patterns is a logical prerequisite.
APIs typically exchange JSON; JSON serialization/deserialization is needed before integrating.
Shared observable state is used in declarative UI to drive recomposition; understanding declarative paradigm is foundational.
Shared observable state is typically implemented using publisher-subscriber; understanding pub/sub is a prerequisite.
Two-way binding relies on declarative UI concepts where state drives UI and UI events update state.
UI modifiers are part of a declarative UI toolkit; understanding declarative paradigm is necessary first.
